# Project Manager Profile - Analysis Document

## Task: Project Manager Profile & Task Management System

**[Objective]:** Design a Project Manager AI profile for codx-junior that manages Kanban tasks, team coordination, project roadmaps, and provides project status visibility.

---

### Requirements

- Create a `project_manager` profile with appropriate tools for task and Kanban management
- Tools to read, update, and move tasks across Kanban boards/columns
- Tools to list and notify team members (other profiles)
- Roadmap data model and management (new feature)
- Project status reporting capabilities
- Profile must integrate with existing `ChatManager` and Kanban infrastructure

---

### Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `project_manager.profile` file created with correct metadata and tool list
- [ ] `kanban_tools.py` module created with Kanban read/write operations
- [ ] `roadmap_tools.py` module created with roadmap CRUD operations
- [ ] `team_tools.py` module created for listing profiles and triggering agent actions
- [ ] Roadmap data model defined (schema/Pydantic model)
- [ ] All new tools registered in `api/codx/junior/tools/__init__.py`
- [ ] Existing `ChatManager.save_kanban` / `load_kanban` reused (no duplication)
- [ ] Profile content (system prompt) covers all PM responsibilities

---

### Documentation

#### Architecture Overview

```mermaid
graph TD
    USER["User"] --> PM["ProjectManager Profile"]
    PM --> KT["kanban_tools"]
    PM --> RT["roadmap_tools"]
    PM --> TT["team_tools"]

    KT --> CM["ChatManager\n(load_kanban / save_kanban\nlist_chats / save_chat)"]
    RT --> RM["roadmap.json\n(.codx/roadmap/)"]
    TT --> PL["Profile Loader\n(.codx/profiles/*.profile)"]
    TT --> GT["generate_tasks_tool"]

    CM --> FS["File System\n(.codx/tasks/<board>/<column>/*.json)"]
    RM --> FS2["File System\n(.codx/roadmap/*.json)"]
```

#### Kanban Data Model (existing)

```mermaid
erDiagram
    KANBAN {
        float version
        dict boards
        dict tags
    }
    BOARD {
        string name
        list columns
    }
    CHAT {
        string id
        string name
        string board
        string column
        string status
        int chat_index
        string updated_at
    }
    KANBAN ||--o{ BOARD : contains
    BOARD ||--o{ CHAT : contains
```

#### Roadmap Data Model (new)

```mermaid
erDiagram
    ROADMAP {
        string id
        string name
        string description
        string created_at
        string updated_at
    }
    MILESTONE {
        string id
        string roadmap_id
        string name
        string description
        string status
        string due_date
        int order
    }
    ROADMAP_ITEM {
        string id
        string milestone_id
        string chat_id
        string title
        string status
        string priority
        list tags
    }
    ROADMAP ||--o{ MILESTONE : contains
    MILESTONE ||--o{ ROADMAP_ITEM : contains
    ROADMAP_ITEM }o--|| CHAT : references
```

#### File Structure

```
.codx/
├── profiles/
│   └── project_manager.profile        ← NEW
├── tasks/
│   └── kanban/
│       └── <column>/
│           └── <slug>.<id>.json       ← existing chats/tasks
└── roadmap/
    ├── roadmap.json                   ← NEW: list of roadmaps
    └── <roadmap_id>.json              ← NEW: individual roadmap detail
```

#### New Tools

| Tool | Description | Module |
|------|-------------|--------|
| `kanban_list_tasks` | List tasks filtered by board/column/status | `kanban_tools.py` |
| `kanban_move_task` | Move a chat/task to a different board/column | `kanban_tools.py` |
| `kanban_update_task` | Update task metadata (name, status, index) | `kanban_tools.py` |
| `kanban_get_board` | Get full kanban board structure | `kanban_tools.py` |
| `roadmap_list` | List all roadmaps | `roadmap_tools.py` |
| `roadmap_get` | Get a specific roadmap with milestones | `roadmap_tools.py` |
| `roadmap_create` | Create a new roadmap | `roadmap_tools.py` |
| `roadmap_update` | Update roadmap or milestone | `roadmap_tools.py` |
| `roadmap_add_milestone` | Add milestone to a roadmap | `roadmap_tools.py` |
| `roadmap_link_task` | Link a chat/task to a milestone | `roadmap_tools.py` |
| `team_list_profiles` | List available agent profiles | `team_tools.py` |
| `team_assign_task` | Assign a task to a profile/agent | `team_tools.py` |

#### Profile System Prompt Design

The profile content must instruct the PM to:
1. Always fetch current board state before making changes
2. Use `kanban_list_tasks` before `kanban_move_task`
3. Provide clear status summaries using markdown tables
4. Route technical questions to the appropriate profile via `team_assign_task`
5. Keep roadmap milestones linked to actual tasks

#### Tool Registration Pattern (existing convention)

```python
# api/codx/junior/tools/__init__.py
from .kanban_tools import kanban_list_tasks, kanban_move_task, kanban_update_task, kanban_get_board
from .roadmap_tools import roadmap_list, roadmap_get, roadmap_create, roadmap_update, roadmap_add_milestone, roadmap_link_task
from .team_tools import team_list_profiles, team_assign_task
```

---

### Additional Notes

- **Roadmap persistence**: Store under `.codx/roadmap/` (alongside `.codx/tasks/`, `.codx/profiles/`) using JSON, consistent with existing patterns in `ChatManager`
- **`kanban_move_task`**: Must update `chat.board`, `chat.column`, delete the old file path — reuse `ChatManager.save_chat` which already handles this via `find_by_id` + old-file cleanup
- **`team_assign_task`**: Initially a metadata operation (sets a `assigned_profile` field on the chat); full agent-to-agent delegation via `generate_tasks_tool` is a phase-2 enhancement
- **No breaking changes**: All new tools use `settings` injection (same pattern as `generate_tasks_tool`) and the existing `ChatManager` API
- **Roadmap API endpoint**: A new FastAPI router `api/codx/junior/api/roadmap.py` will be needed to expose roadmap operations to the UI — out of scope for this task but should be planned
- **Priority order for implementation**:
  1. `kanban_tools.py` + profile file (immediate value)
  2. `team_tools.py` (coordination)
  3. `roadmap_tools.py` + data model (new feature, more work)
